items.text: `src/infrastructure/comp/persistence/metadados.repository.ts` — implements `MetadadosRepository`; uses `prisma.metadados.upsert`; maps DB record → `Metadados` aggregate (snake_case → camelCase, `materialized=true` on persisted row); `findByProjetoId` uses `prisma.metadados.findUnique({ where: { projetoId } })`

`src/infrastructure/comp/persistence/metadados.repository.spec.ts` — integration test against test DB (or PrismaService mock): upsert creates on first call; upsert updates on second call without duplicate; findByProjetoId returns null on absence
`src/modules/comp/comp.module.ts` — register `MetadadosRepository` under `METADADOS_REPOSITORY` token (replace stub from COMP-001)
Two `upsert` calls with same `projetoId` but different `titulo` result in exactly 1 row with second `titulo`
